## Source and IP boundary (CLAUDE.md Technical Knowledge & IP Source Boundary; research-scout rule)
- Perplexity is source discovery only. A claim counts only after its primary source is fetched directly and recorded:
  publisher / authority, exact identity (title, number, edition / version, date), URL, section and page, retrieval date, SHA-256.
- Record the reuse basis per source in `evidence/ip-and-reuse-register.md`. Unknown or incompatible rights → abstain and record the open IP question.
  Publicly viewable ≠ lawfully reusable. Third-party material inside a usable source is assessed separately. Never copy protected expression.
- Never invent a value, threshold, criterion or source claim. A finding is at most `QUALIFIED-CANDIDATE` — never admitted, never adopted.
- File-level rights evidence (Owner correction 2026-10-28). For every source or reusable technical asset newly recorded, the IP register row states:
  copyright / authorship / publication basis; commercial use, modification, translation and redistribution basis; software or model licence (for code,
  libraries, models); dataset / database rights; protected standards, figures, tables or documentation excluded; third-party material and attribution
  duties; and, separately, material risk notes on patents / freedom-to-operate, trade secrets / confidential information, and trademarks, endorsement
  and contractual / provider terms ("none identified" is allowed; "cleared" is never written). A technically valid source is not thereby reusable,
  and a reusable source never establishes patent clearance. Unknown or incompatible rights stay blocked from product ingestion; this is not legal review.
- Claim-level IP fitness (Owner IP-hygiene task 2026-10-29): each relied-on claim also records the origin of the statement (source's own; restated
  from a cited work; based on a standard; third-party / mixed / unclear), the commercial-use basis (clear / conditional / unknown) and an IP fitness:
  `CALCULATION-GRADE` (may support product or method qualification), `REFERENCE-ONLY` (background only), `IP-UNRESOLVED` or `EXCLUDED` (never reused).
  A passage declared based on a protected standard, or a restatement of a mixed-authorship or publisher-marked work, is `IP-UNRESOLVED` unless a
  clean original is found; a rights conclusion inherited from another record is marked inherited and not re-verified. Standard-derived values, figures,
  tables and long quotations are not stored in this package. Scientific status and IP fitness are recorded separately.

## Query privacy rule (checked before EVERY external call)
Queries are built ONLY from the exact-claim text of `state/question-register.md` plus generic technical terms.
Never include inventor, user, project or session content, nor text from `docs/validation/**`, study corpora, session logs, ILT ledgers or any database.
If a query would need such content, do not send it; record an abstention.

## Six adaptive search lenses (Owner-agreed source-discovery methods)
1. Principle-based · 2. Technology-based · 3. Function-based · 4. Problem-based · 5. Application-based · 6. Source-targeted.
Choose lenses adaptively per question; record the lens used for every query in the run ledger. They are discovery methods, not READ BEFORE BUILD checks.
Source pools for the source-targeted lens (Owner 2026-10-28; persistent; use only where the exact residual needs them, never as a mandatory stage):
CERN (institutional primary source for physics, instrumentation, sensors / detectors, electronics, radiation, vacuum, experimental conditions);
HEPData (measured values, tables, measured relationships, verification data); arXiv (papers, equations / models, operating conditions, limitations,
leads to stronger primary sources — hosting alone is no reuse right); INSPIRE-HEP (discovery / index layer: qualify the underlying inspected
source, not the index record); Project Euclid (selectively, for mathematical foundations, analytical models, differential equations, probability /
statistics, mathematical physics — item-level rights inspected). Preferred order where practical: existing qualified evidence → official /
government / standards primary source → institutional primary source → CERN / HEPData → arXiv / INSPIRE discovery → Project Euclid where
mathematical depth is required → stop. Every rule of this README still applies: a source hosted by these pools that is inaccessible, uninspected
or of unclear item-level rights is not qualified.

## Limits (fixed; never expanded by a run)
- Per run: at most 3 questions worked; at most 12 Perplexity calls, of which at most 1 `perplexity_research`; at most 15 direct primary-source fetches.
- Per question: at most 20 queries in total; after 3 runs without progress → `BLOCKED` with the exact reason.
- Campaign: at most 20 research runs, 30 days from activation, 240 queries — whichever first. The preflight counts as no run and uses no query.

## Run protocol (each scheduled wake-up)
1. `git fetch origin research/tech-sources-001` and work on that branch at its remote tip. Confirm this README's base line is unchanged.
2. Read `state/campaign-status.md`. If it is not `ACTIVE`: do no search, no push and arm no wake-up; end the run.
3. Re-read the live authority text on `feature/atomic-json-session-persistence` (`CLAUDE.md` Current authority, `docs/governance/ACTIVE_INCREMENT_CONTRACT.md`
   first Current-authority section). If it materially changes this research (pause, revocation, a register question delivered or settled), stop (step 7).
4. If `research/tech-sources-001/STOP` exists, stop (step 7).
5. Work at most 3 ELIGIBLE questions (definitions in `state/question-register.md` "Selection and depth rules", Owner correction 2026-10-28):
   eligible = `QUEUED`, `IN_PROGRESS` or `PARTIAL` without a `WAITING` note. Order: every eligible Tier 1 question first, in register order; then
   (Owner remaining-run discipline 2026-10-28) every eligible Tier 2 `PARTIAL` residual, P1 → P2 → P3; then `QUEUED` Tier 2 questions by
   priority P1 → P2 → P3, register order within a priority, except that a queued question whose result could support a calculation, engineering
   condition or verification step comes before a reference-only one of the same priority (e.g. Q-29, Q-32 before Q-27). Reuse inspected sources before any new search; stop work on a question once it is terminal. On a `PARTIAL` question, search only its recorded residual — never repeat an
   established point. A question becomes `QUALIFIED-CANDIDATE` only when its applicable depth dimensions are established or recorded as
   unavailable, not because one introductory source was found; it becomes `EXHAUSTED` when its residual has no reachable lawful source after the
   lenses tried (recorded), or its 20-query cap is reached. If no question is eligible, the run may derive at most 3 new Tier 2 rows under the
   derivation rule (from the recorded future-technology concerns listed there only, P1 first), record them, and work them; if none can be derived,
   that counts as "every question terminal".
   GitHub-first (Owner 2026-10-28, every question, before any external query): read only the repository evidence materially related to the
   question — this package's `evidence/` and findings; on the base branch (read only) admitted method contracts and method-authority artifacts
   (`docs/governance/`), domain-pack provenance (`domains/*/domain.json`, `domains/domain_provenance.json`), reference groups and delivered methods
   whose sources overlap the question. Reuse each source only within its recorded claim, keeping its EXPLICIT / IMPLIED, DIRECT / LEAD-SUPPLIED,
   IP and reference-versus-calculation boundaries (a new use outside that claim is checked separately). Record what is already established and
   the exact residual; search externally only for that residual. A question that repository evidence already closes is closed by recorded reuse with
   zero external queries. Two stored facts never establish their relationship unless a source states it.
6. Record: sources, IP basis, abstentions, blocked hosts (never retry a host that returned 403 in the same run), findings, contradictions;
   append one run-ledger row (date, run number, questions, queries per lens, fetches, cumulative totals, outcome). Commit and push. A push that fails twice → stop.
   Run report (Owner 2026-10-28): return only the questions worked; the exact status delta; new qualified source IDs; D1–D7 dimensions now sourced;
   remaining `UNVERIFIED` dimensions; EXPLICIT / IMPLIED caveats; DIRECT / LEAD-SUPPLIED status; IP / reuse caveats; usefulness class; any new
   BLOCKED / WAITING / EXHAUSTED / IP UNRESOLVED state; per question the repository source IDs and D1–D7 dimensions reused, the residual
   dimensions searched externally and the external query count; budget used; the next eligible question; the next scheduled run's trigger id and fire time —
   never domain-level status, never the whole history. Any material qualification delta goes to the Execution Lead for bounded NEXT-LOOP assessment;
   no run jumps to a later technology because it is easier to source.
   Work the fewest questions needed and do not spend budget because it exists; never repeat a failed search without a changed path.
7. Stop conditions: every question terminal (terminal = `QUALIFIED-CANDIDATE`, `EXHAUSTED`, `BLOCKED`, `AUTHORITY BLOCKED`, `QUESTION UNCLEAR`,
   `IP UNRESOLVED`, `SOURCE ACCESS BLOCKED`, `HELD`, `EXCLUDED`, `ABSTAINED`, or `PARTIAL` with a `WAITING` note) and no row derivable under step 5; any limit reached; 3 runs in a row without progress; STOP file; authority change; branch / base mismatch;
   push failed twice; Perplexity connector missing (never substitute another method); an Owner decision required to continue; a privacy or authority conflict.
   To stop: write `STOPPED: <reason>` to `state/campaign-status.md`, commit and push, and schedule NO next wake-up.
8. Scheduling (Owner-authorized 2026-10-27, replaces the cron mechanism): only after step 6 pushed and the remote tip was verified, and only if no
   stop condition holds, arm exactly ONE `send_later` one-shot into THIS session (`session_01UZzqphd9HQzNoRidheKeZN`) 6 hours later (Owner-authorized cadence change 2026-10-27; was about 24 hours),
   named `TECH-SOURCES-001 run N+1`, and record its trigger id and fire time in the run-ledger row. Before arming, `list_triggers enabled=true`
   must show no other pending TECH-SOURCES-001 wake-up (never overlap). The cron task `trig_01QRwqYuFRU8jBNG9oH2DiTz` stays disabled and is never re-enabled.
   If arming fails, record it in `state/campaign-status.md`; the chain then ends (no retry with another mechanism). Delivery is not guaranteed.

## Preflight protocol (run only when the wake-up text says PREFLIGHT ONLY)
No Perplexity call, no source fetch, no research. Record each check as PASS / FAIL with evidence in `state/preflight.md`:
- P1 branch: on `research/tech-sources-001` at the remote tip; README base line present.
- P2 resumption: the scheduled wake-up reached this dedicated session (state the session id and the wake-up text received).
- P3 connector: Perplexity Research tools are available (load their schemas with ToolSearch; do NOT call them).
- P4 persistence / push: commit `state/preflight.md` and push it to `research/tech-sources-001`; report the pushed SHA; note any permission prompt.
- P5 stopping: `list_triggers` shows the task `InventorAI research TECH-SOURCES-001`; call `update_trigger` with `enabled=false` on it and
  confirm it reads disabled (this also holds the schedule until the Owner's campaign authorization). Record the result, commit and push again.
- P6 privacy: confirm no external query was sent during the preflight.
Do not change `state/campaign-status.md`.
